description: For one app: which parts are set up (script, server errors, source maps, deploys, revenue) and a ready prompt with the steps for what's missing. Keys stay hidden unless you pass reveal_keys (write access only); never repeat them in chat. Only know the repo's URL? Use find_app first.

app.description: The app: its slug, name, domain (shop.app), URL or id. list_apps shows them all.

reveal_keys.description: Include the real DSN, upload key and proxy key, to write into .env.local or the host's env. Needs write access. Never paste them into the chat.

name: get_setup_status
